name: clear-and-erase
about: ED clears the viewport IN PLACE. alacritty optimises this by scrolling trailing blank rows away instead of writing blanks over cells that are already blank, and on the primary grid that scroll reaches history - so a plain CSI 2J pushes a line into scrollback that the reference never created, and every client indexing history by monotonic count shifts. The v2 Zig core clears in place; the Rust side is roost patch P4.
patch: ED on the primary screen clears the visible cells without scrolling
